input.summary: Remove the non-compete/field-of-use restriction on the Company in Section 6.1, including HDI's exclusive right over our own "Deerskin" brand.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a restriction on the projects or products we may pursue, or an HDI exclusive right over our own "Deerskin" brand, so we have converted Section 6.1 into an express permission; our position is no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on the Company. If HDI needs protection, we could discuss a restriction limited to a named competing product, during the term only, capped at 12 months, with carve-outs for our internal development and acquisitions.

ops.oldText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
ops.newText: 6.1 The Company may participate in any project on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products, and HDI shall have no exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand.
